watches.name: Venture Velo Nocturne
watches.description: A familiar route feels different after sunset. White road markings catch the light, the air cools, and the next turn offers a reason to keep going. The Venture Velo Nocturne brings that evening mood to the Velo series, pairing a black-and-white colourway with a black bezel, pushers, and crown. The Velo story began with our Ride to Conquer Cancer watch and the riders who put kilometres behind a cause that mattered. The Nocturne carries that connection forward with a crisp contrast of light and dark, framed by the Venture’s distinctive titanium case. At 41mm, the lightweight case sits comfortably alongside a black nylon strap. A flat sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating covers the printed matte dial, while Japan Superlume on the dial and hands helps you read the time as daylight fades. Inside, the Japanese SII VK64 movement keeps things moving. For the ride home, an evening loop, or a day that takes an unexpected turn, the Venture Velo Nocturne is a watch to wear often and make your own. Take the long way home. There may be something you missed in daylight. watches.name: Venture Umbra
watches.description: A Different Kind of Darkness. Not all blacks are created equal. The Venture Umbra explores the absence of light with a Superkuro Musou black dial that absorbs an extraordinary amount of visible light, creating an almost bottomless appearance. Against this dark canvas, the hands and hour markers stand out with striking clarity. Powered by the Miyota 8217 automatic movement, Umbra features a subtle 24-hour indicator that offers a simple way to distinguish day from night. Pointing right indicates AM, while pointing left indicates PM. A small, thoughtful detail that complements the watch's exploration of light and darkness. Housed in our signature 38mm titanium Venture case, Umbra combines its unusual visual character with everyday practicality. Lightweight, durable and equipped with a sapphire crystal and 200m water resistance, it's built to be worn, not just admired. A familiar field watch, seen in a different light. Less to see. More to appreciate. watches.name: Odyssey Bronze Aventurine
watches.description: The chunky brute is back with a brand new grainy-textured dial! The Odyssey Bronze Aventurine gets its name from the quartz gem also known as the 'Stone of Opportunity'. Not only does the name Aventurine remind us of adventure, but the stone is said to bring luck to those who come in contact with it. Strap this on and live the BOLDR life - you'll find plenty of opportunities to make your own luck. As with all Bronze Odysseys, the Marine Grade CuSn8 bronze case will develop a unique patina with time which will create a distinctive character for each and every piece. This organic individualization perfectly represents the BOLDR ideal, letting each wearer tell their own unique story. The Odyssey’s signature bezel has been updated with an aluminium insert as a call back to classic dive-watch bezels. Ride rough with an ultra-tough case rated for up to 500m water resistance, a screw-down crown with triple lock mechanism, a resilient Japanese Automatic movement and special helium escape valve to make sure your watch stays strong under intense pressure. A custom caseback depicts an old map-style compass rose that sets the tone for the Odyssey's overall theme. Designed by artist Stephen Mazinger, at North is an early Greek boat; a symbol commonly used for water. At West is the Egyptian symbol for the sun and a pyramid. East depicts an early jet, and the fires of Hades blaze at the South with an anvil for crafting tools. These symbols encompass travel, exploration, discovery, adventure - exactly what the Odyssey is built for. watches.name: Odyssey Bronze Slate Grey
watches.description: Our patina-friendly CuSn8 bronze Odysseys are back with a bright new surprise. If you think you've seen lume, think again - the ultra-bright markers on each watch are made from Lumicast ® , a specially-casted 3D lume. The term '3D' is used to depict the raised nature of the markers, which are built by combining ceramic parts with Swiss Super-LumiNova®. This makes the material of the dial markers themselves highly luminescent, with superior brightness compared to printed or sandwich dial lumes. The raised markers also act like 'batteries' that use sunlight to charge during the day in order to glow powerfully at night. Coupled with a high double dome crystal and our iconic Odyssey design, this bright brute is as dive-ready as they come. Rated for 500m water resistance, the custom embossed triple lock screw-down crown and our very own Druber® fluoroelastomer rubber strap make this watch the perfect amphibious timekeeper. At 45.5 mm, these divers are built for adventurers with larger-sized wrists. Each model is limited to 100 pieces with individual serial numbers. watches.name: Odyssey MGP
watches.description: Introducing the Odyssey MGP, a timepiece crafted with a purpose as profound as the depths of the ocean it aims to protect. Born from our commitment to the Marine Genome Project, this exceptional diver's watch encapsulates the spirit of exploration and dedication to safeguarding our marine ecosystems for generations to come. Crafted entirely in resilient titanium, from bezel to bracelet, the Odyssey MGP weighs a mere 125 grams, offering unparalleled durability against the harshest elements. The luminous dial features a captivating glow-in-the-dark DNA strand, encircled by bubbles symbolizing our unwavering dedication to preserving marine life—ensuring a legacy where we won't have to describe the wonders of whales and corals to our children. Embrace the convenience of the 40mm diver, designed with a quick-adjust buckle on its screw-in link bracelet, allowing effortless length adjustments—up to three, without the need for any tools. Whether adapting to the nuances of your wrist or accommodating dive suits, the Odyssey MGP seamlessly fits your lifestyle. The vertical brushing on its surface provides a crisp finish, accentuating the watch's angular lugs, while the screw-down crown ensures a water-resistant depth of up to 300m—perfect for exploring the mysteries beneath the waves. As a testament to our commitment, BOLDR proudly endorses the Marine Genome Project and welcomes Daniel Ortega as our esteemed Brand Ambassador. Join us in supporting this groundbreaking initiative and discover how you can actively contribute to the cause by visiting https://marinegenomeproject.org/ . Elevate your timepiece to a symbol of purpose with the Odyssey MGP—where style meets substance, and every tick counts towards a sustainable future for our oceans. *About the DNA artwork: The Odyssey MGP's dial artwork depicts Z-DNA, a left handed DNA structure observed in some biological functions including: transcription, replication, regulation of gene expression, repair, enhancing frequencies of recombination, deletion, relocation events, and several autoimmune diseases. The Marine Genome Project chose to utilize a left handed DNA helix to represent the importance of marine genetics as a tool to better understand not only the health of our oceans, but how human health is directly tied to our blue planet. It also pays tribute to close family and friends of the organization who suffer from autoimmune diseases. SPECIFICATIONS Case: 40mm titanium brushed finishing. watches.description: This special edition Venture is a collaboration with Five In A Row, a Scottish-rowing crew competing in the 2021 Talisker Whisky Atlantic Challenge (TWAC). The crew will cover 3000 miles from La Gomera in 2-hour shifts, 24 hours a day without stopping until they reach their destination at Antigua - all in the name of an important cause. They intend to raise awareness for Reverse Rett, a UK-based charity that supports victims of Rett Syndrome which currently afflicts the daughter of a crew member. Through various partnerships and tireless fund-raising efforts, the money raised will contribute towards medical research in hopes of finding a cure for this debilitating disease. We created this BOLDR x Five In a Row Venture to help each member keep track of their rowing shifts. This watch boasts every aspect of a tough titanium Venture field watch, with two never-before-done features specially for the race; a two-tone tide indicator on the bezel, and a 10 o'clock crown position to avoid damage to the wrist while rowing. T he bezel has a 12 hour scale to indicate the tides, but more importantly it helps the rowers easily keep track of 2 hour shifts. 15% of proceeds from this watch will go towards Reverse Rett, so we thank you kindly for contributing to the cause! While pursuing his dream of being an independent graffiti artist, Malaysian-born Kenji Chai drew inspiration from an unlikely source - the many stray dogs that littered the outskirts of KL city. Growing up in a broken family, Kenji could relate to being estranged, having to fend for himself from a young age. Unlike the strays, however, he had the power to decide from then on to live life on his terms. And thus, Chaigo was born. The image of the neon blue stray dog with his tongue sticking out represents the spirit of having fun with life and never giving up. Incidentally, Kenji is born in the year of the dog, and Chaigo is a combination of his surname with the Mandarin word for dog, ‘Go’. These elements are artfully merged by overlaying the topographic pattern with the Star of Life, featuring a heartbeat line that seamlessly integrates BOLDR’s logo at the center. This harmonious design captures the essence of the Field Medic concept, creating a visually compelling artwork that instantly connects with the watch’s adventurous and purposeful story.
